g.title: SEND
g.text: Include current chat identity and requested stream

g.title: DELIVERY
g.text: Do not invent an assignment or claim

g.title: BOARD
g.text: and selects one existing task leaf in that stream

g.title: HOLD
g.text: Resolve the specific ambiguity or dependency
Hold that assignment until its gate is satisfied

g.title: BIND
g.text: Bind exact task, worker identity, files,

g.title: MANUAL
g.text: Coordinator records the claim and assignment
using the current manual board/ledger workflow

g.title: STRUCT
g.text: exact request digest to an authorization grant

g.title: QUEUED
g.text: Task and intended worker are selected
Worker has not been told to start

g.title: DRAIN
g.text: Process a bounded amount of queued work

g.title: WORK
g.text: Preserve peers and respect explicit effect gates

g.title: REVIEW
g.text: Release ownership or bind a correction
